discovery.scope: New local Codex chats using this profile
discovery.behavior: Automatically select relevant helpers for authorized project work; delegated workers receive toolkit context

limitations: Static inspections do not certify full ABI or actual Windows loader contexts; unknown/unsupported evidence remains nonpass.
DLL contract execution requires explicit trust and occurs only in child; inspection helpers never load their targets.
Real Lua syntax/mock tests do not establish real WoW API, taint or game execution.
Android artifact checks do not certify all ELF/page-size/release policy requirements; actual unsigned fixture correctly fails signature.
Real-device, Windows Sandbox lifecycle and fresh online advisory gates remain unperformed unless recorded.
Other profiles/machines/products require their own discovery guidance and folder access.

writes: New selected destination
